facts.fact: The Minister Delegate for Public Contracts says the COLEPS platform, whose second version was launched on 25 June 2025, handles tender notices and online bid submission for public contracts.

The Cameroon Tribune says COLEPS runs the whole public contracts process from tender notice to monitoring of contract execution, and a 27 December 2024 ministerial order makes exclusive electronic award compulsory from the 2027 financial year, regional and local authorities included.

CMR.note: Power cuts mentioned only in a question, no figure.
Local authorities' future COLEPS use is not a stated connection.
